auth_details: Bearer token (personal API token or service account) via Authorization: token YOUR_API_KEY or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY; self-serve signup
free_tier_limits: Free plan for individuals (limited tests/projects; exact API quotas not published on public pricing)
paid_plans: Team and Enterprise plans with higher limits and org features; see snyk.io/plans
description: Snyk provides REST and legacy APIs for vulnerability scanning of open-source dependencies, containers, and IaC. Developers authenticate with personal or service-account tokens to list organizations/projects, pull vulnerability findings, and integrate security checks into CI/CD and agent workflows.
